svg.title: Whisper — say it softly, it arrives instantly
svg.desc: Animated banner for Whisper, a real-time chat app. The Whisper wordmark draws itself, a typewriter line cycles through features (real-time messaging over Socket.IO, live online presence, image sharing via Cloudinary, JWT auth guarded by Arcjet, keystroke and notification sounds) and a small conversation floats on both sides.

g.text: Say it softly — it arrives instantly.
live online presence for every contact
